# Pallet Designer

> Pallet Designer is a tool for industrial automation integrators
> and manufacturing plants for configuring palletizing layouts without
> programming the PLC or HMI. It cuts the time to start up a new layout
> from days to minutes — layer pattern design, mixed-product palletizing,
> motion sequencing and export of the configuration to the machine.

## Key facts
- Product: Pallet Designer
- Industry: industrial automation, palletizing, depalletizing
- Target users: automation system integrators, manufacturing plants, PLC/HMI programmers, robot programmers, sales teams for palletizing machines
- Sales model: annual licence + optional one-off integration; perpetual licence available
- Vendor: Pallet Designer (Marcin Daniun Automatyka, Poland)

## Features
- Palletizing layer pattern configurator without PLC/HMI programming
- Mixed-product palletizing on a single pallet (variant mix)
- Split of the layout into robot pick-and-place sequences
- Generation of data ready to load into the machine (CSV, JSON, custom structures)
- Ready function blocks, HMI screens and scripts for Siemens PLC/HMI
- Configuration export for robot simulation environments (e.g. RoboGuide)
- Automatic PDF documentation of the layout
- Feasibility and safety validation of the layout
- Self-service mode: end-customer configurator (an operator or process engineer designs layouts themselves, within parameters set up by the integrator)

## Pricing model
- All prices are net (VAT added). Every quote is confirmed in a written offer before ordering.
- Integrator licence (one design seat, annual subscription): from 12,000 PLN/year net (PL market) or from EUR 2,800/year net (EN/DE markets). Includes full program functionality, data export to the machine, files for robot simulation, PDF documentation, user manual and team training; works without permanent internet; transferable between devices.
- Team pack (several seats in one company) and perpetual licence (one-off, roughly equivalent to five years of subscription): quoted on request.
- End-customer application licence: quoted on request; depends on the number of machines, lines and plants at the end customer; available as a perpetual licence or an annual subscription; deployment packs for further lines or plants of the same customer.
- Machine integration: one-off, quoted by scope; depends on the controller platform (Siemens standard: ready PLC function blocks, HMI screens and scripts, team training, assistance at first commissioning); other control systems, extra export formats, MES/ERP integration and on-site training quoted after agreeing the scope.
- Before buying: 20-minute online demo on the customer's own pallet layout, followed by a tailored offer.
